sloka: योजनानि त्रयोविम्शत्सुवेलमधिकृत्य वै ।स वानरवरः श्रीमान् विश्वकर्मात्मजो बली ॥६-२२-७१॥।।
transliteration: yojanāni trayovimśatsuvelamadhikṛtya vai ।sa vānaravaraḥ śrīmān viśvakarmātmajo balī ॥6-22-71॥।।

translations.english: Nala the son of Vishwakarma, the foremost of the Vanaras and strong like his father built the bridge in the sea.
